main_text.l: sint vel dignitatis, vel conditionis, ac status, legitimis Magistratibus subjici debent, il-lisque vectigalia ac tributa pendere, & ijs in omnibus obsequi ac obedire, quæ verbo DEI non repugnant: preces etiam pro ijs fundere, ut eos DEVS in omnibus ipsorum actionibus dirigere dignetur, nos vero vitam tranquillam ac quietam sub ipsis, cum omni pietate & honestate, ducere possimus. Quamobrem Anabaptistas & turbulentos omnes detestamur, qui superiores Dominationes & Magistratus abjiciunt, jura ac judi-cia pervertunt, bona omnia communia faciunt, ac denique ordines ac gradus, quos DEVS honestatis gratia inter homines constituit, abolent ac confundunt.

l.i: I. Magistratui Christiano non licere fontes gladio, seu pœnâ capitali punire: neque licere Christianis in bello sanguinem humanum fundere.

main_text.l: A WELSINGIO, De Offic. hom. Christ. fol. 1. Cum Christi præceptis pugnat, quod apud Evangelicos conceditur, ita vim vi repellere, ut etiam hominem interficere liceat, si aliter vis repelli nequeat: præsertim vero cum bellum injustum nobis infertur.

page.notes: The initial numeral "I." of the thesis is printed in italic type, the thesis itself is set in italic with a large woodcut-free opening; the "Contra hunc Articulum" line is a centred rubric in roman type and was given level 3. The apostrophe-like mark after "ita" in the note reads as a printed mark, not a letter, and was left out. The "S" at the foot is a gathering signature. No marginal notes on this page.
